name: Mor'Ladim
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Pays 35s instead of 25s. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?

There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
narrative.objectives: Kill Mor'Ladim, then return his skull to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: You killed him? That's no small accomplishment, adventurer! On behalf of the people of Darkshire and the Night Watch, I thank you.Ah... there is one small matter, however...
narrative.requestItemsText: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, adventurer. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
